rule: ISO 639-1 code.
open_access = full text freely and legally available; paywalled = full text under a subscription; abstract_only = only the abstract was available.
primary = the document that reports the study most fully; regulatory = an FDA or EMA summary of the study; secondary = any other document reporting it. Exactly one primary per study.
description: The document's role for this study.

rule: prospective_trial = dogs enrolled and followed forward under a protocol (including regulatory studies); retrospective_cohort = review of existing records of a defined group; case_series = descriptive report of several cases with no comparison; other = none of these.

pilot = called pilot, preliminary or feasibility; dose_determination = compares two or more doses of the same treatment to find the effective dose; dose_confirmation = confirms a chosen dose against a control; field_effectiveness = efficacy in clinical patients at fixed doses; safety = main aim is safety or tolerance; pharmacokinetic = main aim is drug levels; other = none of these.
INTERVENTIONAL = treatment assigned by the study protocol; OBSERVATIONAL = treatment given in routine care, retrospective review, cohort.
COMPLETED when results are reported and no early stop is stated; TERMINATED when an early stop is stated; RECRUITING or ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING only as stated by a registry entry; otherwise UNKNOWN.
